stages.reference: Create a close visual reference for the bark-covered side of a mature oak trunk in an old grounded dark-fantasy forest. The oak should feel dependable, heavy and deeply established. Build thick interlocking bark ridges with irregular vertical breaks, compressed plates, old healed scars and subtle dirt lodged in recesses. Weather has dried exposed high points while rain has darkened deeper channels, giving age without theatrical decay. Use restrained brown, gray-brown and muted umber tones. Avoid pine-like straight furrows, jungle moss coverage, carved faces, giant fantasy fissures or photographic sharpness everywhere. Establish oak as the world's archetypal temperate timber: strong, coarse, weathered and long-lived. This is a bark material study, not a reproduction of the source pattern.
